description: This source file contains parsing functions for handling command-line options and configuration parameters within a Git-related application, including validation and conversion of option arguments.

methods.name: int parse_opt_abbrev_cb(const struct option * opt,const char * arg,int unset)
methods.description: Handles parsing of abbreviation options, setting the value based on string input or default.

methods.name: int parse_opt_expiry_date_cb(const struct option * opt,const char * arg,int unset)
methods.description: Parses expiry date options, converting string to timestamp or setting to 'never'.

methods.name: int parse_opt_color_flag_cb(const struct option * opt,const char * arg,int unset)
methods.description: Parses color flag options into internal enumeration.

methods.name: int parse_opt_verbosity_cb(const struct option * opt,const char * arg,int unset)
methods.description: Adjusts verbosity level based on command-line arguments.

methods.name: int parse_opt_commits(const struct option * opt,const char * arg,int unset)
methods.description: Parses commit object names and inserts into a commit list.

methods.name: int parse_opt_commit(const struct option * opt,const char * arg,int unset)
methods.description: Parses a single commit object name and assigns the corresponding commit object.

methods.name: int parse_opt_object_name(const struct option * opt,const char * arg,int unset)
methods.description: Parses object names into an object ID array.

methods.name: int parse_opt_object_id(const struct option * opt,const char * arg,int unset)
methods.description: Parses object IDs into a target object ID.

methods.name: int parse_opt_tertiary(const struct option * opt,const char * arg,int unset)
methods.description: Sets internal target value based on presence or absence of arguments.

methods.name: size_t parse_options_count(const struct option * opt)
methods.description: Counts the number of options in an options array.

methods.name: struct:option * parse_options_concat(const struct option * a,const struct option * b)
methods.description: Concatenates two options arrays into a new array.

methods.name: int parse_opt_string_list(const struct option * opt,const char * arg,int unset)
methods.description: Parses a string list option, appending strings.

methods.name: int parse_opt_strvec(const struct option * opt,const char * arg,int unset)
methods.description: Parses a string vector option, adding string arguments.

methods.name: int parse_opt_noop_cb(const struct option * opt UNUSED,const char * arg UNUSED,int unset UNUSED)
int recreate_opt(struct strbuf * sb,const struct option * opt,const char * arg,int unset)
methods.description: Recreates command-line options in a string buffer for passing to other commands.

methods.name: int parse_opt_passthru(const struct option * opt,const char * arg,int unset)
methods.description: Creates a string representation of an option for passthrough.

methods.name: int parse_opt_passthru_argv(const struct option * opt,const char * arg,int unset)
methods.description: Appends command-line options to a vector for passthrough.

methods.name: int parse_opt_tracking_mode(const struct option * opt,const char * arg,int unset)
methods.description: Parses tracking mode options for branches, setting internal enums accordingly.
